messages:
leah (eng-platform): Heads-up — we need a cross-team decision on what GPU metrics the runtime should emit for both Hosted and Dedicated pools. Main asks: SM occupancy, per-device free memory (headroom), and request queue_depth so we can do better routing + console visibility.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Agreed. We can emit those but we need to settle on metric names/labels and cardinality. Proposing Prometheus-like names: `redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy{pool,device}`, `redwood_gpu_memory_free_bytes{pool,device}`, `redwood_gpu_request_queue_depth{pool,queue}`.

maria (eng-sre): +1 on metrics, but watch labels. `device` can explode for Dedicated (many GPUs) — suggest `device_id` only when `env=dedicated` and otherwise aggregate to `instance_type` or `node_role`. Also prefer gauges for occupancy and memory, histogram for queue latency. Alerts we care about: sustained occupancy >90% for 5m, free memory <10% for 2m, queue_depth >50 for 1m.

oliver (product-analytics): For Console dashboards we need both aggregated per-pool views and per-customer slices for Dedicated. UX asks: default top-level charts should be pool-level aggregates (hosted vs dedicated) and a drilldown that filters by `customer_id` or `reservation_id` for Dedicated. We also need annotations for rollouts so customers can correlate spikes to model changes.

carmen (eng-infra): Implementation note: current metric pipeline dedups labels at ingest — high-cardinality `customer_id` would be dropped unless we change retention/rollups. We can send raw `customer_id` with a separate low-cardinality `customer_bucket` label for dashboards. That keeps ingest <10k series.

leah (eng-platform): Can we agree on a minimal contract for the runtime emitters so eng-platform can wire dashboards and product can plan UI? Something like: (1) gauge `redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy{pool,zone,device_type}` (percentage), (2) gauge `redwood_gpu_memory_free_bytes{pool,zone,device_type}`, (3) gauge `redwood_gpu_request_queue_depth{pool,zone,queue_class}`. Optional labels: `customer_id` (redacted/hashed), `reservation_id`.

sanjay (eng-runtime): That contract looks ok. A couple clarifying points: 
- `queue_class` -> short/long/batch? we can map request types.
- We'll emit `device_type` instead of device_id by default and add `device_id` only behind a feature flag for Dedicated.
- Units: occupancy in percent (0-100), memory in bytes, queue_depth as integer.

maria (eng-sre): For alerting and SLOs, we also need `redwood_gpu_utilization_core_seconds_total` (counter) to compute utilization over time windows. Counters are easier for burn-rate SLOs.

leah (eng-platform): Noted — add utilization counter to contract. Also ask: how often will runtime push metrics? 15s default? 10s? That affects dashboard resolution.

sanjay (eng-runtime): We'll default to 15s emit interval. Can expose option in Dedicated config to 5s for tight SLAs.

oliver (product-analytics): For Console UX: include both instant (current) and windowed (1m/5m/1h) series. Add a small sample: "Top 5 busiest customers by queue_depth" card for Dedicated. Need the hashed `customer_bucket` to compute top-k without exposing IDs.

carmen (eng-infra): Agree. Also we should precompute rollups in ingest: `pool:gpu_sm_occupancy:avg` and `pool:gpu_memory_headroom:95pct` to speed dashboards.

infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: runtime-metrics-emitter v2.3 -> staging at 2026-03-19T02:00Z.

leah (eng-platform): Next steps / owners: 
- Sanjay to draft the emitter RFC with metric names + label rules and example payloads (due EOD Thu).
- Carmen to validate ingest pipeline capacity and rollup plan (sync meeting Friday).
- Maria to propose alert thresholds and add initial runbook snippets.
- Oliver to mockup Console cards and drilldowns (mockups by next Tue).

maria (eng-sre): I'll also add a canary alert to watch for cardinality spikes when we enable `customer_id`.

sanjay (eng-runtime): RFC link: https://redwood-internal/rfcs/metrics/gpu-emitter (drafted, PTAL). I included sample payload: 
```
{
  "timestamp": 1640000000,
  "pool": "hosted",
  "device_type": "a100-80gb",
  "redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy": 72.4,
  "redwood_gpu_memory_free_bytes": 12084984960,
  "redwood_gpu_request_queue_depth": 3
}
```

leah (eng-platform): Great — I'll pick this up and stub out Grafana/Console queries for the dashboard. Meeting to finalize contract Friday 09:30 PT in #eng-platform — ping me if you can't make it. :calendar: :speech_balloon:

oliver (product-analytics): LGTM. One more ask: add an optional `model_family` label so we can correlate hot models to utilization spikes. Hash if needed.

sanjay (eng-runtime): `model_family` ok as optional label (hashed). Will add to RFC.

leah (eng-platform): Perfect — closing thread here. I'll post an agenda and attach mock queries before the meeting. Thanks everyone :rocket:
